products.note: Analytics automation with AI; data blending; workflow governance; self-service analytics risk

reading.body:
Alteryx provides analytics automation software that integrates AI for data blending and self-service analytics, positioning itself in the data preparation layer rather than model development or inference.

The distinction matters for AI infrastructure. Data quality and preparation consume significant engineering effort before any model sees input, yet the compute requirements here are modest compared to training or deployment. Alteryx sits upstream of the inference path, automating the human work of structuring raw data into usable form. This belongs to the broader stack, but it is not where compute constraints tighten.

The data covers a single product line and does not specify deployment scale, customer base, infrastructure needs, or power consumption. It identifies what Alteryx does, not the resource requirements that would connect it to the binding constraints on AI scaling. The category label "Data & Analytics AI" is broad enough that the actual role in any particular AI project—whether critical or peripheral—remains unclear from this entry alone.

profile_text.body:
Alteryx is a data analytics and automation company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Irvine. It describes itself as an agentic analytics and automation company that helps organizations turn complex data into trusted insights, decisions, and action. Its platform, Alteryx One, is presented as a business logic layer that works across an organization's existing data and AI ecosystem, letting business analysts bring AI-ready datasets and business logic into visual workflows that they govern and deliver to LLMs, agents, BI tools, and business applications. The site says the platform integrates with Snowflake, Databricks, and BI tools.

The company's tracked product is Alteryx AI, listed under Data and Analytics AI, covering analytics automation with AI, data blending, workflow governance, and self-service analytics risk. Alteryx says Alteryx One acts as a governed AI automation layer that cleans, optimizes, and routes data and business logic before invoking expensive AI models, an approach it says can lower token costs by more than 90%. It describes every workflow the platform produces as visible, understandable, repeatable, and auditable, and says it is rated a leader across multiple 2026 analyst evaluations. The site cites McLaren Racing using Alteryx AI data analytics to collect and analyze data on and off the track, and features sessions with CEO Andy MacMillan, MIT's Dr. Barb Wixom, Steve Nouri, Nezrin Noushad, and Anthony Alteirac at the Alteryx Virtual Summit.

The company's record shows no lawsuits and no MCP servers.
